name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Pool invites now require consent: adding an already-connected friend to a pool used to enroll them immediately and only notify them afterward (and that notify endpoint was mis-configured so it silently never worked at all) - it's now a real invite with Accept/Reject, matching how friend requests already worked, shown in a new 'Pool invites' section on the Pools tab. Pools also get an optional icon, spread peer-to-peer through the same roster-sync notice used for membership changes - no central image host. New Discovery tab: asks your current friends who their other friends are (reusing the existing opt-in friends-of-friends primitive) and lists what it finds with a one-click 'Add friend' - never contacts or adds anyone automatically, purely a search/browse aid over servers you're already one hop from. Also fixes the Catalog tab's BrowseLocalItems endpoint throwing an unhandled exception (returned as an unparseable plain-text error page) instead of a proper JSON error. 231 tests, all green.
